exchange_prompt: Paper-based Structured Communication Protocol adaptation: Exchange stage {exchange_number} of 2.
The initial group front-runner, determined from the pre-discussion votes and held fixed for both Exchange stages, is {front_runner}.
Contribute 1 or 2 concrete, decision-relevant facts available to you. Then give one evidence-based reason why the current front-runner may be incorrect.
Do not invent facts. Do not reveal every fact mechanically. Keep your public message concise (one or two sentences). Do not give private chain-of-thought.
decide_prompt: Paper-based Structured Communication Protocol adaptation: Decide stage.
Summarize the strongest evidence bearing on the available candidates and state the main uncertainty that remains.

Do not add facts that are not available to you or mechanically disclose all your information. Do not vote in this message. Keep it concise (one or two sentences); do not provide private chain-of-thought.
notes: These stage prompts operationalize the published paper's prose description; they are not claimed to be the authors' verbatim prompts.

The first-seen plurality among initial votes defines a fixed initial front-runner reference for both Exchange rounds; this is an implementation choice because the public protocol description does not specify how front-runner is computed or updated.
Decide is one public summary generation per agent. The subsequent independent final vote uses the existing V1 vote prompt and parser as the evaluation step.
